svg.title: CA system with display, UART and buttons

g.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Segoe UI', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: aclk: MIG user clock, 81.25 MHz (registers, controller, reader, writer, UART, buttons)
eclk: 200 MHz (line-buffer read side, window, rule, packer)
pclk: 148.5 MHz (video timing, 1920 x 1080 at 60 Hz)
VGA: RGB (4 bits per colour), HSYNC, VSYNC
1. The host uploads the seed over
core runs a pass and streams
4. Under PAUSE the host can read
clock-domain crossing (async FIFO, dual-clock RAM, toggle handshake)
Solid arrows: data (AXI4, AXI4-Lite, AXI4-Stream and the external links); dashed: control and configuration.
One pass: front buffer → frame reader → line buffer → window → rule → packer → FIFO → frame writer → back buffer.
